::: {#fig-ecdf-sample-quantile-example layout-ncol="2"}

::: {#fig-ecdf-example}

```{r}
#| fig-width: 5
#| fig-height: 4
x <- c(4, 1, 7, 3)
n <- length(x)
x_ord <- sort(x)
p_ord <- seq_len(n) / n
ecdf_x_padding <- 0.8
x_min <- min(x_ord) - ecdf_x_padding
x_max <- max(x_ord) + ecdf_x_padding

x_left <- c(x_min, x_ord)
x_right <- c(x_ord, x_max)
f_levels <- c(0, p_ord)

plot(
  0,
  0,
  type = "n",
  xlim = c(x_min, x_max),
  ylim = c(0, 1.05),
  xlab = "t",
  ylab = expression(hat(plain("F"))(t))
)
segments(x_left, f_levels, x_right, f_levels, lwd = 2, col = "blue")
points(x_ord, f_levels[seq_len(n)], pch = 1, col = "blue")
points(x_ord, f_levels[seq_len(n) + 1], pch = 19, col = "blue")
```

Empirical CDF, horizontal pieces only.
Closed circles mark included endpoints;
open circles mark excluded endpoints.

:::

::: {#fig-eqf-example}

```{r}
#| fig-width: 5
#| fig-height: 4
eqf_y_padding <- 0.5
q_left <- c(0, p_ord[-n])
q_right <- p_ord
plot(
  0,
  0,
  type = "n",
  xlim = c(0, 1),
  ylim = c(min(x_ord) - eqf_y_padding, max(x_ord) + eqf_y_padding),
  xlab = "p",
  ylab = expression(hat(Q)(p))
)
segments(q_left, x_ord, q_right, x_ord, lwd = 2, col = "blue")
points(q_left, x_ord, pch = 1, col = "blue")
points(q_right, x_ord, pch = 19, col = "blue")
```

Sample quantile function, horizontal pieces only.
Open circles mark excluded left endpoints;
closed circles mark included right endpoints.

:::

The empirical CDF and the sample quantile function
for the data 4, 1, 7, 3
(order statistics 1, 3, 4, 7).

:::
